summary_md: **Kuz ([@_Kuz_Kuz_](https://x.com/_Kuz_Kuz_/status/2115124010505920999))** presents **Frameboard** (vid-flow), a local board that turns a script into finished AI video shot by shot: an agent writes prompts and the user approves each step (ComfyUI/LTX-based; an entry for the #OpenSourceHiggsfield contest).
relevance: Human-in-the-loop agentic video pipeline on local models.
